description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling API endpoints related to final evaluation of performance reviews. It includes methods for updating and retrieving performance review data, validation rules, and integrates with various services and models for managing performance review workflow states.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for managing the final evaluation of performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. Handles updating review evaluations, retrieving final reviews, and validation rules.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to finalize and update performance review evaluations, committing changes within a transaction, and setting review status.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific finalized performance review by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update endpoint including review ID, complete flag, and final evaluation data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a review by ID, ensuring access permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws an exception if called.

methods.name: setFinalEvaluation
methods.description: Sets the final evaluation data on a PerformanceReview object based on request parameters.
